thought.text: Lass mich vom VPS selbst testen:

reasoning_content: Strange. Let me check server logs more carefully. Server had HTTP 200 before which suggests the server is listening but something is off.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Test from localhost
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000")
print("HTTP local:", stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s http://localhost:3000 | wc -c")
print("Bytes:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
